Q24.entry: continuous live enabled carrier aura, not attack trigger; no mana/cooldown/SPELL_EFFECT/RNG
Q24.targets: enemy ground organic, nonundead(non native UNIT_TYPE_UNDEAD), nonstructure, nonmechanical, not Aloc/hidden/invulnerable/ethereal; magic immune allowed by physical Disease classification
Q24.infect: entering closed500 circle creates per-source infection; while eligible inside, expiry=now+100s (continuous); leaving/death of emitter stops refreshing; source deletion removes its tracks; target death/deletion/type-ineligible clears tracks
Q24.tick: per logical source infection track: first at its initial infection+1s then each1s; refresh retains its phase. Different source tracks each tick, same-time B04/B05 order, not max or merged; include endpoint tick then expire; no secondary spread
Q24.packet: each actual emitter S,false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL,WHOKNOWS raw DPS; after native reductions and before map callback cap eventInput=min(max(0,reduced),max(0,currentLife-2)); zero capped amount produces no new damage event.
